acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass introduces the show and goes straight to Act One.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Bim Adewunmi talks about the feeling of now.
acts.title: Letter From America

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Producers Diane Wu and Lina Misitzis spend the night at a corner grocery store in Brooklyn, New York and talk to some of the people that pass by.
acts.title: Before Sunrise

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc:
Ira watches videos of police behavior at protests. The videos were pulled from a Twitter thread (and corresponding spreadsheet) created by T. Greg Doucette, who has collected more than 600 of them to date.
Then, a protest that wasn’t supposed to happen. An organizer with no experience organizing. Dana Chivvis tagged along on one demonstration in Red Hook, Brooklyn.
acts.title: Grand Army

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Writer Kimberly Jones provides context with a brief history of the American economy, told through a popular board game.
acts.title: Do Not Pass Go, Do Not Collect $200
